logo_design.icon: Stylized playing card with a prominent '10' and a curved flip/turn motion arrow across the card face
logo_design.style: Glossy rounded card silhouette with subtle gold foil stroke, crimson rank '10' in top-left and bottom-right, flip symbol centered

theme.concept: Casino Velvet & Dark Obsidian playing card lounge

styling.card_bg: bg-gradient-to-br from-slate-50 via-slate-100 to-slate-200 text-slate-900 shadow-md rounded-md border border-slate-300

navigation.styling: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 max-w-md mx-auto bg-[#121620]/95 backdrop-blur-md border-t border-[#2A3447] z-50 px-2 py-1 flex items-center justify-around

hem.logged_out: Hero title 'Turn10' with animated card logo, tagline, fast Login and Register options.
hem.logged_in: Personal dashboard: mini-overview card with avatar+nickname+rating, prominent 'Starta Ny Match' CTA, quick access to recent matches, 'Månadens bästa spelare' badge spotlight, and active 'V-ringad' vote alert banner if open.

ny_match.round_table_visualization: Interactive SVG/CSS round felt green table showing player avatars positioned dynamically around the circle with position numbers (1..6).
ny_match.rule_picker: Selectable rules displayed as CARD-SHAPED tap-to-toggle elements (aspect-ratio, playing card borders, suits/card icons). Includes base Vändtian rules pre-selected + inline custom rule creator with icon choices (♥♦♣♠, card silhouettes, flip icons).
ny_match.result_entry: Set final placements (1st to Nth) and pick each player's exit card using the PlayingCard component.
ny_match.elo_feedback: Instant Elo adjustment display showing base placement score and separate exit bonus breakdown (e.g., '+5 för att ha gått ut på en 3:a').
ny_match.spela_igen: Quick restart button prefilling the same players and selected rule set.

historik.list_view: Match cards with date, player count, winner highlight, exit card badge, and expand/detail button.
historik.detail_modal_page: Full match summary with round table placements, active card-shaped rules, exit card rendered via SVG/CSS PlayingCard component, Elo changes breakdown, and comments section with text + emoji support.

topplista.leaderboard_table: Rankings list with rank, avatar+nickname, rating, wins, losses, last places, win %. Sortable by all columns.
topplista.historical_monthly_winners: Archive list at bottom showing previous monthly champions with trophy indicators.

regler.official_rules: Structured Swedish Vändtian rules guide (cards 2-A special effects, turn 10 flip mechanics, double deck rules).
regler.rule_library: Card-shaped custom rule cards with editable user rules and toggleable status for matches.

min_sida.avatar_builder: Preset gallery of background colors + suit symbols/monograms, plus custom avatar color/symbol generator.
min_sida.patch_notes_link: Direct link/tab to Patch Notes page.

monthly_v_ringad_vote.description: Monthly pop-up voting modal: 'Vem har betett sig som att man bär V-ringat?'. Allows group members to cast a vote for a friend once per month.
monthly_v_ringad_vote.badge_reward: Top voted member receives the 👕 V-ringad badge on leaderboard.

testing_attributes.rule: Every interactive element (button, input, select, card, avatar, tab) MUST have a unique data-testid in kebab-case format.

image_urls.description: Jack of spade playing card dark tone
Luxury royal playing cards on dark background

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Always reference the app as Turn10 (never Kortkväll).
Keep all copy and text in Swedish (Svenska).
Maintain dark casino aesthetic: deep obsidian (#090B10) background, gold accents (#F59E0B), playing-card crimson red (#E11D48).
Rules and selectable options must be rendered as CARD-SHAPED elements (rounded corners, card aspect ratios), never standard square chips.
The SVG/CSS PlayingCard component must render suit symbols ♥♦♣♠ and corner ranks clearly across all pages (New Match, Match Detail, History).
Include round table SVG visualizer when selecting players for a match.
Ensure Elo rating breakdown explicitly shows separate exit bonus e.g. '+5 för att ha gått ut på en 3:a'.
All interactive elements must have clear data-testid attributes.
